_note: Manually curated 2026-09-13 from Parks tennis pages/rules. Sites whose play model flips in the indoor season. Windows are MM-DD, inclusive, and may cross year-end.

M010.name: Central Park Tennis Center
M010.season_note: Outdoor permit/sign-up play ~April-November; bubble (paid indoor) play in winter - no walk-ons then.

B068.name: Prospect Park Tennis Center (Parade Ground)
B068.season_note: 11 courts; 8 open to Parks permit holders in the outdoor season. Bubble season Oct 23 - May 6: paid indoor rental.

SUPP-QO.name: Queensboro Oval (Sutton Tennis)
SUPP-QO.season_note: Parks permit play Apr 14 - Sep 14 (6 of 8 clay courts). Rest of year: Sutton East indoor booking, paid.
